Bessent:

The Financial Times is anti-American, anti-business, anti-Western values.

WSJ isn’t a business paper. The only thing I read on them is book reviews. https://t.co/rBEe8xisNq

Bessent:

People say to me, "stock market is going up on bad news."

I say it’s not bad news; the news coverage is bad.

The term "fake news" is not enough. https://t.co/eZHE8TlKs0

Bessent on Canada:

I don’t want to do any grave dancing here, but Canada lost more than 40,000 jobs, and we had a blowout jobs number.

Our message at the G20 was, “Come and grow with us.” https://t.co/XXEDwEL2e0
